choices.prompt: Should we go to Drakenberg to go shopping, or go to the Elven Forest to see pretty ladies?
choices.goodText: As the villagers nearby were hoping, the couple decided to go shopping in Drakenberg and ended up having a wonderful date. They even brought you a gift.
choices.badText: The villager sent her boyfriend to the Elven Forest alone and kept muttering—it seems that she is complaining about your bad ideas.

choices.prompt: How can I make my girlfriend not angry anymore after accidentally using up all of her perfume?
choices.option2: Give her something delicious to eat
choices.goodText: The villager and his girlfriend have reconciled and are more lovey-dovey together than ever.
choices.badText: The girlfriend thinks the villagers don't understand romance and broke up with him for good.

choices.prompt: What should we do about the mice in the warehouse?
choices.goodText: The cat proves quite useful and quickly culls the rodent population. The apothecary has returned to normal.
choices.badText: Maxim stayed up for several nights but didn't catch anything, which also ended up affecting his work during the day...

choices.prompt: How can we attract more customers to the Spring Resort?
choices.goodText: You can never go wrong with free stuff— business at the Spring Resort immediately picks up.
choices.badText: Not many people can withstand such high water temperature, let alone the guests...

choices.prompt: What is the best time to sow seeds?
choices.goodText: You got it right! Pump is very happy and gives you a useful tool of his with a big toothy smile.
choices.badText: Wrong answer! Sowing in the cold winter won’t grow a thing...

choices.prompt: How can we solve the strange smell on the girl's body?
choices.goodText: The girl's troubles disappear in an instant and she soon becomes the most popular girl around.
choices.badText: Wrapping up tightly makes people sweat, and when you sweat... the troubles of a girl only multiply.

manage.desc: Based on my experience, recruiting more staff can provide better services to customers and make the shop more prosperous.
Why not expand the store so that more customers will come?
Hi, boss, could you level me up or something? This way I can make more money for you. After all, it's my personal affair…
A strong body can shoulder more burden. A proficient fellow can provide more productions. Try to improve your fellow's skills!
You've been working hard recently. Please upgrade some employees. They'll help you with your work.
Can we expand the shop? The larger the shop is, the more customers will come.

dialog.CityDailyEvent02_1: Believe me, dear, I really wasn't drunk.
dialog.CityDailyEvent03_1: My teacher made a bet with me that if I could get into this school, he would treat me to an all-you-can-eat fish meal.
dialog.CityDailyEvent07_1: Can your magic lamp really grant three wishes?
dialog.CityDailyEvent10_1: I really embarrassed myself at the party last night!
dialog.CityDailyEvent12_1: I want to ask, is there a potion that can make my skin greener?
dialog.CityDailyEvent13_1: What an amazing magic show that was! Truly spectacular!
dialog.CityDailyEvent14_1: The dental clinic next to my house posted a notice prohibiting patients with colds from getting dental treatment.
dialog.CityDailyEvent15_1: I've always been curious, how do elves wear earrings?
dialog.CityDailyEvent17_1: What if we live in a game world?
dialog.CityDailyEvent18_1: I've always had bad luck, and I'm always afraid of dying an untimely death.
dialog.CityDailyEvent19_1: The weather is so hot and unbearable, and there are so many mosquitoes!
dialog.CityDailyEvent21_1: What is the meaning of life?
dialog.CityDailyEvent04_1: We've known each other for a long time, and today I have to confess something to you.
dialog.CityDailyEvent08_1: What does it feel like to have a tail? How do you make it move?
dialog.CityDailyEvent09_1: Oh no! Hurry home and hide your valuables!
dialog.CityDailyEvent05_1: There are a lot of mushrooms growing in the forest recently, and I picked some. They taste really delicious.
dialog.CityDailyEventSelect1_1: Dear, let's go shopping in Drakenberg~
dialog.CityDailyEventSelect2_1: I mistook my girlfriend's newly bought perfume for a watering can and sprayed half of it away in one breath.
dialog.CityDailyEventSelect3_1: Sir, I suspect that there are mice in the apothecary's warehouse. What should we do?
dialog.CityDailyEventSelect4_1: Recently, there haven't been many guests at the Spring Resort.
dialog.CityDailyEventSelect5_1: Boss, let me test you. When should we plant crops?
dialog.earningsGoal1-1: Hello, my name is Grayce. I am here to provide personal VIP service to you, {playerName}.
dialog.earningsFinish1-1: I didn't think the goal would be achieved so quickly. It seems I'm destined to serve you, Lord {playerName}.
dialog.earningsGoal2-1: Excuse me, I am Denisa, the accountant of the Trading Post. Here is my business card.
dialog.earningsFinish2-1: The official document has been approved. From now on, I will work here as an official accountant.
dialog.earningsGoal3-1: Pump holds a letter in his hand, looking troubled. You call out to him several times before he responds.
dialog.earningsFinish3-1: Thank you, Lord. My family saw our village in the tabloid and finally agreed to come!
dialog.earningsGoal4-1: Hello! You must be {playerName}, right? My name is Brotein, and I'm here to thank you!
dialog.earningsFinish4-1: Thank you for your work. My private fitness class is already booked two months in advance.
dialog.earningsGoal5-1: Excuse me for bothering you. The Trading Post is holding a competition to promote the economic development of the nearby villages.
dialog.earningsFinish5-1: I passed the assessment. It's all thanks to you.
dialog.earningsGoal6-1: My savior, it's nice to see you again.
dialog.earningsFinish6-1: Your marketing skills are amazing... The customers just keep coming... Even merchants from nearby towns have shown up.
dialog.W1E1Goal1-1: Gina? Why are you standing here all alone?
dialog.W1E1Goal2-1: The next morning, you accompany Gina to the Inn.
dialog.W1E1Goal3-1: You arrive at the village gate as agreed and see Reir talking to Gina from a distance.
dialog.W1E1Goal4-1: It's a new day and the sun is shining. Gina is holding a bouquet of fresh flowers and waiting for you at the village entrance.
dialog.CityEvent2-1: Such a wonderful village, everyone is so welcoming.
dialog.CityEventB1-1: Help! Oh God, please, someone help me...!
dialog.CityEvent1-1: It's time to repay the debt. The usurious merchant arrives on schedule.
dialog.CityEventB3-1: It's alright now. You don't need to be scared anymore. You're free now.
dialog.CityEventH03-1: Aah... Given the boot again, alas...
dialog.CityEventH14-1: The harvest at the farmstead has been good lately. You can smell the fragrance of a bountiful harvest from far away~
dialog.CityEventH12-1: {playerName}, do you have a moment? I want to talk to you about something.
dialog.CityEventH51-1: A group of villagers have gathered in a raucous circle and seem to watching someone.
dialog.CityEventH11-1: Are you from the inn? Your meat has arrived, please check the quantity.
dialog.CityEventH15-1: Haha~ Today is a perfect day for fishing! Big fish, here I come!
dialog.CityEventH17-1: Hey hey... The secret vintage of the Fairy Folk is ready~
dialog.CityEventH16-1: Hello! I'm a baker who's currently on a journey of self-discovery, I'm trying to learn about the recipes and flavors of different places.
dialog.CityEventH20-1: Huh? When was this statue placed here? I don't remember this being here...
dialog.CityEventH21-1: How is this hat floating in mid-air!? Have I been... have I been working too hard?
dialog.CityEventH18-1: Fresh, jumping life... *Kukukuku*.... Such enviable vitality.
dialog.CityEventH25-1: Ah, {playerName}! Over here! I've been looking for you.
dialog.CityEventH22-1: Hello, so we finally meet! The greatest lord I've ever known!
dialog.CityEventH24-1: Hi! Are you, {playerName}? I'm a manager, I'm responding to the job opening at the farmstead!
dialog.CityEventH61-1: (Hey... isn't that Cimitir? Why does she look so upset...? I should ask her.)
dialog.CityEventN1-1: And one more request, {playerName}, I hope you can stay and become our Village Elder.
dialog.Wife65_GainDialogue1_1: As you stroll along the street, a strangely dressed elf girl suddenly stops you.
dialog.Wife66_GainDialogue1_1: This day, returning to the village, you find Gina playing with a young figure at the entrance…
dialog.Wife69_GainDialogue1_1: At night. After finishing trade work in Drakenberg, you set off for home, back aching.
dialog.CityEventB3-1-MaleFamily: (He didn't refuse, but it feels like there's something he wants to say...)
dialog.Wife6_GainDialogue1_1: On this day, you plan to count the loot left by Pridet with the goblins.
dialog.Wife1_GainDialogue1_1: On this day, you plan to count the loot left by Pridet with the goblins.
dialog.CityEventC4-1-MaleFamily: Will? What are you looking at?
